title: Win partners, build honest agents, plan 90 days of growth

say: Win partners, build an honest agent network, and plan 90 days of growth.
This is the video for module 3: Winning Partners, Building an Agent Network and Planning Growth.
A shop owner's real question is not, is this product nice? It is, will it sell from my shelf and make me money without trouble?

panel.heading: What a shop owner really asks
items: Will it sell from my shelf?
What do I earn per unit?
Will you deliver on time, every time?
What happens if something goes wrong?

say: So your pitch answers with facts. Your one-page sell sheet shows the price, the trade price, and the shop's margin per unit in naira.

say: Step one. List 10 to 15 outlets whose customers match yours: pharmacies, salons, gyms, mini-marts.

say: Step four. Let them try the sample, tell them what they earn per unit, and offer a small trial, for example 12 units, reviewed after 4 to 6 weeks.

say: Step five. Follow up the same day. And put the trial in writing. A no today is often a not yet, so return politely on the date they give you.

panel.rule: Agree every trial in writing: quantity, price, terms, review date.

say: For example, Amaka sells shea body butter. She got trial orders at a pharmacy and a gym. Sell-through is the share of delivered stock that sells. The pharmacy sold 9 of 12 jars, which is 75%, and reordered.

panel.heading: Sell-through tells you what to do

say: The gym sold only 3, which is 25%. Members did not see the jars, and staff could not answer questions. So she offers a shelf sign and a 15-minute staff briefing. If sales stay low, she collects her stock and moves on.

panel.heading: Sell-through tells you what to do

say: Agents carry your product into places you never visit, and they carry your reputation too. Look for a hairdresser, a fitness coach, a women's group leader.

panel.heading: Recruiting agents the honest way
items: Pick people who talk to your customers daily
Take a referee and a copy of a valid ID
Start with 3 to 5 agents you can support
Same published terms for every agent
Never promise income or charge a joining fee

say: Ask for a referee, take a copy of a valid ID, and record their phone number and area.

say: Start with three to five agents you can train well, not twenty you cannot follow up.

say: Keep the same terms for every agent at the same level, for example 10% commission, rising to 12% above 50 units a month.

say: Never promise income you cannot prove, and never charge a fee to join. Schemes that earn from recruiting people, not selling products, are a warning sign of a pyramid scheme.

say: Teach these rules in every training, and have each agent sign the agreement. First, cash: customers pay into your business account, never into an agent's personal account.

cards.d: Customers pay into your business account or payment link, never an agent's personal account.
Give new agents only a small amount of stock, and record every unit issued.
Keep customers' numbers and addresses private. No adding them to groups without permission.

say: Second, stock: limit what a new agent holds until trust is built, and record every unit.

cards.d: Customers pay into your business account or payment link, never an agent's personal account.
Give new agents only a small amount of stock, and record every unit issued.
Keep customers' numbers and addresses private. No adding them to groups without permission.

say: Third, data: customer phone numbers and addresses stay private.

say: In October her agents sold 40, 25, 12, 8 and 0 jars.
That is 85 jars, or 340,000 naira of sales.
She pays 34,000 naira in commission.
Ifeoma, her best agent, earns 16,000 naira. Amaka asks her to share her approach on the next agent call.
Ruth has sold nothing for two months, so she is offered a refresher or a friendly exit. And customers asking for a smaller size becomes a product idea.
Now plan one new channel for 90 days. In days 1 to 15, fix your gaps. Amaka adds a production day and sets aside 200,000 naira of working cash.

say: In days 61 to 90, measure sell-through, payments and true profit.
Write number targets before you start, like at least 3 outlets reordering. Grow in pharmacies cannot be judged at day 90.

say: To remember. Pitch with facts and a small written trial, and judge it by sell-through and reorders.
Keep agents honest with clear terms, and money going only to your business account.
At day 90, expand, adjust or exit using your targets. One channel done well beats three opened at once.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Pitch with facts: margin, terms, proof of sales
Judge trials by sell-through and reorders
Payments always go to your business account
At day 90: expand, adjust or exit
One new channel per 90 days, done well
